sous_titre: Milliards de dollars investis par trimestre, du troisième trimestre 2025 au deuxième trimestre 2026

T3 2025.texte: Investors allocated $111.7 billion across the major asset classes in Q3, a 15% jump compared to last year.

T4 2025.texte: Investors allocated $142.8 billion across the major asset classes in Q4, a 19% jump compared to last year.

T1 2026.texte: Investment volume reached $110.7 billion, up 18% year over year, extending the recovery that began in mid-2025.

T2 2026.texte: Investment volume reached $113.7 billion, up 9% year over year, marking the third consecutive quarter of near- or double-digit gains
